features: 100% Turkish Cotton, Best choice for luxury hotels, spa, and residence. Long lasting softness after every wash & dry cycle. Minimum pilling and shrinkage. Extra Strong Construction, Ultimate durability with strong double stitched hems

Great Present: Can you think of a better gift to give or receive than fresh bath towels? The best choice to treat yourself, your family and house guests with soft and fluffy bath towels. Great gift for everyone in your shopping list for every occasion, perfect for holidays, as a housewarming gift, a wedding present, mother's day gifts, engagement gifts, bridal showers, birthdays, Christmas and homecoming. Surprise your mom, sister, daughter, dad, or friend.

Made of natural materials, stays fresher longer. Do not use any fabric softeners or conditioners with our towels, they promise fluffy and soft towels but laundry additives coat towels with an invisible chemical film and block their natural ability to absorb water and leave a waxy buildup.

Update the look of your bathroom with fresh towels. Dobby border adds an elegant look to your bathrooms decorative details. You can easily set the mood in the bathroom by matching towel color to overall design theme or color scheme in each bathroom.

Machine washable. Initially wash and dry towels alone to remove extra lint and fluff up your towel. It is normal to see extra lint during first few dry cycles. Wash Towels Separately from the Rest of the Laundry. Do not over dry towels this will destroy your towels fibers.
